text:
elaine: Heads up — several NCCL allreduce jobs in us-east-1g started hanging after today's kernel rollout (6.5.0 -> 6.5.3). Seen on g5.2xlarge pools. Stuck around 25%.

(tariq pinged)

tariq: which hosts? any logs?

elaine: node list: g5-ue1-03, g5-ue1-07, g5-ue1-12, g5-ue1-24

ben: ops-bot shows a kernel-6.5 deployment at 09:10 to that shard :deploy:

ops-bot: deploy completed: kernel-6.5.3 -> 09:10 UTC — affected hosts: g5-ue1-*

jun: paste dmesg/snippet?

elaine: here's the relevant dmesg from g5-ue1-12:

```
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: mlx5e: qp 5683 error: IB_EVENT_QP_FATAL (status 0x5)
mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: IBV_EVENT_COMM_EST: addr handle not found
gpudirect: mkey invalidation for pd 0x7ff... seq 0x2
nv_peer_mem: peer memory returned -22
```

tariq: nv_peer_mem -22 is EINVAL during reg. Could be mkey churn. Any kmsg about devlink/cmd or switch flaps?

elaine: also saw 'async port err: port 1 pkey violation' and mlx5_eswitch messages earlier. No ToR logs yet.

ben: could be PMTU/fragmentation — kernel offload changes earlier today might have changed GRO/TSO behavior.

jun: try `ibv_rc_pingpong` between two bad nodes and run `trace-cmd`? also check `ethtool -k` offloads.

elaine: ran ibv_rc_pingpong — it completes but sometimes reports `wc->status=LOCAL_LEN_ERR` on recv.

tariq: LOCAL_LEN_ERR often comes from MTU mismatch or SG list fragmentation when TSO/GSO interacts with IB. What's `ip link` MTU and `rdma link show`?

elaine: MTU on host NICs shows 9216, but checked the ToR for g5-ue1-12 — port is 1500. config drift on that port.

ben: that would do it — asymmetric PMTU leads to fragmented packets hitting the RDMA stack poorly, nv_peer_mem can't pin/reg pages -> mkey invalidation and QP errors.

jun: quick mitigation: disable tso/gso/gro/lro with `ethtool -K <iface> tso off gso off gro off lro off` on affected hosts and restart the pods that make heavy GPUDirect calls.

elaine: applying disable now to g5-ue1-12 and g5-ue1-24... :spinner:

ops-bot: runbooks:rdma -> incident channel notified

elaine: after disabling offloads, NCCL jobs progressed past 25% on two nodes. one node still choked.

tariq: check for asymmetric routing: `ip route get <peer-ip>` and `traceroute -n -F <peer-ip>` to verify DF/MTU handling.

elaine: traceroute shows a mid-fabric load balancer rewriting path to a 1500-only link for g5-ue1-12.

ben: plan: revert kernel on the affected shard (rollback job queued) and file a ticket with network vendor for ToR MTU mismatch. also add a fleet job to verify pairwise MTU across us-east-1g.

jun: add these automated checks to CI: `ibv_devinfo` health, `nvidia-smi topo -m`, and pairwise `ip link` MTU diff check pre-merge/deploy.

sre-rotation: noted. i'm taking the handoff — i'll continue rollback and coordinate with networking to fix the ToR port.

elaine: current status: 3/4 nodes recovered (offload disable + restart), one node in rollback queue. i'll update when rollback completes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
